flashcards.example: This match is merely a friendly, so don't worry too much about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场与排名、投注等无关的比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这场比赛只是一场友谊赛，所以不用太担心。

flashcards.definition: To or towards the inside of.
flashcards.example: Mary danced into the house.
flashcards.definitionZh: 向或朝向...的内部。
flashcards.exampleZh: 玛丽跳进屋里。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: (degree) To a given extent or degree.
flashcards.example: "The ribbon was that thin." "I disagree, I say it was not that thin, it was thicker... or maybe thinner..."
flashcards.definitionZh: （程度）达到给定的范围或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: “丝带就是这么薄。” “我不同意，我说不是那么薄，是更厚……或者更薄……”

flashcards.definition: An additional one of the same kind.
flashcards.example: There is one sterling and here is another
flashcards.definitionZh: 另一件同类型的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里有一枚英镑，这是另一枚

flashcards.definition: To be the setting or time of.
flashcards.example: 1999 saw the release of many great films.
flashcards.definitionZh: 是……的设定或时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1999 年上映了许多伟大的电影。

flashcards.definition: Something being indicated that is similar to something else.
flashcards.example: This is the word SUCH AS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 所指示的事物与其他事物相似。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“如”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Reason
flashcards.example: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 原因
flashcards.exampleZh: 一篇好的文章将涵盖人物、事件、时间、地点、原因和方式。

flashcards.definition: On account (of), for sake (of).
flashcards.example: My life is ruined because of you!
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于（的），为了（的）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的人生都因为你而毁了！

flashcards.definition: That which is similar to, or resembles, something else, as in quality, form, etc.
flashcards.example: This is the word SIMILAR.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与其他事物相似或类似的事物，如质量、形式等。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“相似”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Also; in addition.
flashcards.example: There has been a cutback in federal subsidies. Too, rates have been increasing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 还;此外。
flashcards.exampleZh: 联邦补贴有所削减。利率也一直在上涨。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word greenwich.
flashcards.example: This is the word greenwich.
flashcards.definitionZh: 格林威治这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是格林威治这个词。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) A manufactured item that, though still usable, fails to meet quality control standards.
flashcards.example: They were discounted because they contained blemishes, nicks or were otherwise factory seconds.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）虽然仍可用但不符合质量控制标准的制造品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 它们之所以被打折，是因为它们有瑕疵、划痕或者是工厂次品。

flashcards.definition: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds (one-sixtieth of an hour).
flashcards.example: You have twenty minutes to complete the test.
flashcards.definitionZh: 等于六十秒（一小时的六十分之一）的时间单位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您有二十分钟的时间来完成测试。

flashcards.definition: A time period of sixty minutes; one twenty-fourth of a day.
flashcards.example: I spent an hour at lunch.
flashcards.definitionZh: 时间为六十分钟；一天的二十四分之一。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我花了一个小时吃午饭。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: (grammar) A word that modifies a noun or describes a noun’s referent.
flashcards.example: The words “big” and “heavy” are English adjectives.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）修饰名词或描述名词所指对象的词。
flashcards.exampleZh: “大”和“重”这两个词是英语形容词。

flashcards.definition: Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life.
flashcards.example: The innkeeper brought them food and drink.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何可以被生物体消耗的固体物质，特别是通过进食来维持生命。
flashcards.exampleZh: 旅店老板给他们带来了食物和饮料。

flashcards.definition: One's male offspring.
flashcards.example: Before the birth of the man's child, he said: "I want a son, not a daughter."
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的男性后代。
flashcards.exampleZh: 男人的孩子出生前，他说：“我想要一个儿子，而不是女儿。”

flashcards.definition: One’s female offspring.
flashcards.example: I already have a son, so I would like to have a daughter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的女性后代。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我已经有一个儿子了，所以我想要一个女儿。

flashcards.definition: A male fellow member of a religious community, church, trades union etc.
flashcards.example: I would like to thank the brother who just spoke.
flashcards.definitionZh: 宗教团体、教堂、工会等的男性成员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 谢谢刚才发言的兄弟。

flashcards.definition: A daughter of the same parents as another person; a female sibling.
flashcards.example: My sister is always driving me crazy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与他人同父母的女儿；一个女性兄弟姐妹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我姐姐总是让我发疯。

flashcards.definition: One of the two persons from whom one is immediately biologically descended; a mother or father.
flashcards.example: This is the word PARENTS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个人中的一个，其中一个在生物学上是直接后裔；母亲或父亲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是父母这个词。

flashcards.definition: The manner in which two things may be associated.
flashcards.example: The relation between diet and health is complex.
flashcards.definitionZh: 两个事物可能关联的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 饮食与健康之间的关系很复杂。

flashcards.definition: Someone in the same family; someone connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
flashcards.example: Why do my relatives always talk about sex?
flashcards.definitionZh: 同一个家庭中的某个人；因血缘、婚姻或收养而有联系的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为什么我的亲戚总是谈论性？

flashcards.definition: A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; for example, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.
flashcards.example: Our family lives in town.
flashcards.definitionZh: 彼此有密切关系（血缘、婚姻或收养）的一群人；亲属;例如，一组父母和他们的孩子；直系亲属。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们家住在城里。

flashcards.definition: The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.
flashcards.example: This is the word UNCLE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 父母的兄弟或姐夫。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是叔叔这个词。

flashcards.definition: The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.
flashcards.example: This is the word AUNT.
flashcards.definitionZh: 父母的姐妹或嫂子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是阿姨这个词。

flashcards.definition: The child of a person's uncle or aunt; a first cousin.
flashcards.example: I think my cousin is a good man.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个人的叔叔或阿姨的孩子；堂兄。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我认为我的表弟是一个好人。

flashcards.definition: To a greater degree or extent.
flashcards.example: I could no more climb that than fly!
flashcards.definitionZh: 在更大的程度上或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我无法攀爬它，就像无法飞翔一样！

flashcards.definition: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces.
flashcards.example: The femur has a clean break and so should heal easily.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物分成两块或更多块的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 股骨已完全断裂，因此应该很容易愈合。

flashcards.definition: A means of exit, escape, reprieve, etc.
flashcards.example: They wrote the law to give those organizations an out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 退出、逃脱、缓刑等的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们制定了法律来给这些组织一个机会。

flashcards.definition: An act of thinking; consideration (of something).
flashcards.example: I'll have a think about that and let you know.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种思考的行为；考虑（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我会考虑一下并告诉你。

flashcards.definition: (when with and) Very, extremely. See good and.
flashcards.example: The soup is good and hot.
flashcards.definitionZh: (when with and) Very, extremely.见善与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 汤又好又热。

flashcards.definition: Unfavorable; negative; not good.
flashcards.example: Abducting children is bad for mothers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不利;消极的;不好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 拐卖孩子对母亲来说是不好的。

flashcards.definition: (when with and) Very, extremely. See good and.

flashcards.definitionZh: (when with and) Very, extremely.见善与。
flashcards.exampleZh: 汤又好又热。

flashcards.definitionZh: 不利;消极的;不好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 拐卖孩子对母亲来说是不好的。

flashcards.definition: In the place of something (usually mentioned earlier); as a substitute or alternative.
flashcards.example: I was going to go shopping, but I went dancing instead.
flashcards.definitionZh: 代替某物（通常前面提到过）；作为替代品或替代品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我本来要去购物，但我去跳舞了。

flashcards.example: I could no more climb that than fly!
flashcards.definitionZh: 在更大的程度上或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我无法攀爬它，就像无法飞翔一样！

flashcards.definition: A foodstuff made by baking dough made from cereals.
flashcards.example: This is the word BREAD.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将谷物制成的面团烘烤而成的食品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是面包这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any of various foodstuffs made from other foods or oils, similar in consistency to, eaten like or intended as a substitute for butter (preceded by the name of the food used to make it).
flashcards.example: peanut butter
flashcards.definitionZh: 由其他食物或油制成的各种食品，其稠度与黄油相似，可以像黄油一样食用或用作黄油的替代品（前面带有用于制作黄油的食物名称）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 花生酱

flashcards.definition: Cereal plants, Oryza sativa of the grass family whose seeds are used as food.
flashcards.example: This is the word RICE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 谷类植物，禾本科植物，其种子用作食物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是RICE这个词。

flashcards.definition: A manner of transporting or lifting something; the grip or position in which something is carried.
flashcards.example: Adjust your carry from time to time so that you don't tire too quickly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 运输或提升某物的方式；携带某物的抓握或位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不时调整你的携带方式，这样你就不会太快疲劳。

flashcards.definition: A vote not in favor, or opposing a proposition
flashcards.example: The workers voted on whether to strike, and there were thirty "yeses" and two "nos".
flashcards.definitionZh: 投票不赞成或反对某项提议
flashcards.exampleZh: 工人们投票决定是否罢工，有三十个“是”，两个“不”。

flashcards.definition: (stative) To perceive sounds through the ear.
flashcards.example: I was deaf, and now I can hear.
flashcards.definitionZh: （静态）通过耳朵感知声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我以前是聋子，现在我能听见了。

flashcards.definition: Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
flashcards.example: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做某事或取得某事的动机；能力加上野心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 克拉苏拥有财富和智慧，但庞培和凯撒同样拥有动力。

flashcards.definition: A generally accepted means of exchange and measure of value.
flashcards.example: Before colonial times cowry shells imported from Mauritius were used as money in Western Africa.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种普遍接受的交换手段和价值衡量手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在殖民时代之前，从毛里求斯进口的贝壳在西非被用作货币。

flashcards.definition: Money in general.
flashcards.example: to turn an honest penny
flashcards.definitionZh: 钱一般。
flashcards.exampleZh: 变成诚实的一分钱

flashcards.definition: Any of various units of currency formerly used in the United States.
flashcards.example: the Rhode Island pound; the New Hampshire pound
flashcards.definitionZh: 以前在美国使用的任何各种货币单位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗德岛镑；新罕布什尔镑

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word fewer than.
flashcards.example: This is the word fewer than.
flashcards.definitionZh: 少于这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“少于”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A portable or wearable timepiece.
flashcards.example: More people today carry a watch on their wrists than in their pockets.
flashcards.definitionZh: 便携式或可穿戴计时器。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如今，更多的人将手表戴在手腕上，而不是放在口袋里。

flashcards.definition: A vote not in favor, or opposing a proposition
flashcards.example: The workers voted on whether to strike, and there were thirty "yeses" and two "nos".
flashcards.definitionZh: 投票不赞成或反对某项提议
flashcards.exampleZh: 工人们投票决定是否罢工，有三十个“是”，两个“不”。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word fewer than.
flashcards.example: This is the word fewer than.
flashcards.definitionZh: 少于这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“少于”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.
flashcards.example: Time stops for nobody.   the ebb and flow of time
flashcards.definitionZh: 随着现在和过去事件的过去，不可避免地走向未来。
flashcards.exampleZh: 时间为谁停止。   时间的潮起潮落

flashcards.definition: The period of time that has already happened, in contrast to the present and the future.
flashcards.example: a book about a time machine that can transport people back into the past
flashcards.definitionZh: 已经发生的时间段，与现在和未来相对照。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一本关于时间机器的书，可以将人们带回到过去

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: (modifying a numeral, one to twelve) In conjunction with a numeral, indicates the time within a twelve-hour period (midnight to noon or noon to midnight), specifically the time when the hour hand of a clock points precisely to the symbol or marking corresponding to the designated numeral.
flashcards.example: (rare, nonstandard) What o'clock is it?
flashcards.definitionZh: （修饰数字，一到十二）与数字一起表示十二小时内的时间（午夜到中午或中午到午夜），特别是时钟的时针精确指向与指定数字相对应的符号或标记的时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: （罕见，非标准）现在几点了？

flashcards.definition: Any period of 24 hours.
flashcards.example: I've been here for two days and a bit.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任意 24 小时期间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我来这里已经两天多了。

flashcards.definition: A subdivision of the month into longer periods of work days punctuated by shorter weekend periods of days for markets, rest, or religious observation such as a sabbath.
flashcards.example: A 4-day week consists of Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将一个月细分为较长的工作日，中间穿插较短的周末市场、休息或宗教观察（如安息日）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每周 4 天包括星期一、星期二、星期三和星期四。

flashcards.definition: A period into which a year is divided, historically based on the phases of the moon.
flashcards.example: July is my favourite month.
flashcards.definitionZh: 历史上根据月相划分一年的时期。
flashcards.exampleZh: 七月是我最喜欢的月份。

flashcards.definition: A solar year, the time it takes the Earth to complete one revolution of the Sun (between 365.24 and 365.26 days depending on the point of reference).
flashcards.example: we moved to this town a year ago;  I quit smoking exactly one year ago
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个太阳年，地球完成太阳公转一周所需的时间（介于 365.24 到 365.26 天之间，具体取决于参考点）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们一年前搬到这个小镇；  我一年前就戒烟了

flashcards.definition: (focus) In addition; besides; as well; further; too.
flashcards.example: They had porridge for breakfast, and also toast.
flashcards.definitionZh: （重点）此外；除了;以及；更远;也。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们早餐吃粥，还有吐司。

flashcards.definition: The flesh (muscle tissue) of an animal used as food.
flashcards.example: A large portion of domestic meat production comes from animals raised on factory farms.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用作食物的动物的肉（肌肉组织）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 国内肉类生产的很大一部分来自工厂化农场饲养的动物。

flashcards.definition: A small serving of this substance (typically about one teaspoon), used to sweeten a drink.
flashcards.example: He usually has his coffee white with one sugar.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一小份这种物质（通常约为一茶匙），用于使饮料变甜。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他通常喝白咖啡加一粒糖。

flashcards.definition: The act of counting or tallying a quantity.
flashcards.example: Give the chairs a quick count to check if we have enough.
flashcards.definitionZh: 计算或统计数量的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 快速清点一下椅子，看看我们是否有足够的椅子。

flashcards.definition: Used to indicate source or provenance.
flashcards.example: I got a letter from my brother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于表示来源或出处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我收到了我哥哥的一封信。

flashcards.definition: Unwilling to yield possession of.
flashcards.example: He is very possessive of his car.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不甘屈服占有。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对自己的车占有欲很强。

flashcards.definition: Unwilling to yield possession of.
flashcards.example: He is very possessive of his car.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不甘屈服占有。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对自己的车占有欲很强。

flashcards.definition: My; belonging to me; that which belongs to me.
flashcards.example: This is the word MINE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 我的;属于我的；属于我的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“我的”这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which belongs to you (singular); the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun.
flashcards.example: If this edit is mine, the other must be yours.  Their encyclopedia is good, but yours is even better.  It’s all yours.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于你的（单数）；不带名词的第二人称单数所有格代词。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果这个编辑是我的，那么其他的也一定是你的。  他们的百科全书很好，但你的更好。  都是你的。

flashcards.definition: That which belongs to him; the possessive case of he, used without a following noun.
flashcards.example: The decision was his to live with.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于他的； he 的所有格，不带后面的名词使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他决定接受这个决定。

flashcards.definition: A female person or animal.
flashcards.example: I think this bird is a him, but it may be a her.
flashcards.definitionZh: 女性或动物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我认为这只鸟是他的，但也可能是她的。

flashcards.definition: That which belongs to us; the possessive case of we, used without a following noun.
flashcards.example: This is the word OURS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于我们的； we 的所有格，不带后面的名词使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“我们的”这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which belongs to them; the possessive case of they, used without a following noun.
flashcards.example: This is the word THEIRS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 属于他们的；他们的所有格，不带后面的名词使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“他们的”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) the infinitive mood or mode (a grammatical mood)
flashcards.example: This is the word INFINITIVE.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）不定式语气或语气（语法语气）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是不定式这个词。

flashcards.definition: Helping; giving assistance or support.
flashcards.example: auxiliary troops
flashcards.definitionZh: 帮助；给予帮助或支持。
flashcards.exampleZh: 辅助部队

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word oclock.
flashcards.example: This is the word oclock.
flashcards.definitionZh: 时钟这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“时钟”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Used to indicate source or provenance.
flashcards.example: I got a letter from my brother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于表示来源或出处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我收到了我哥哥的一封信。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: Someone who is beautiful. Can be used as a term of address.
flashcards.example: Hey, beautiful!
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个美丽的人。可用作称呼语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 嘿，美丽！

flashcards.definition: (of people, things, etc) Having a good appearance; good-looking.
flashcards.example: a handsome garment, house, tree, or horse
flashcards.definitionZh: （人、事等）有良好的外表；好看。
flashcards.exampleZh: 漂亮的衣服、房子、树或马

flashcards.definition: Offensive to one's sensibilities or morality.
flashcards.example: He played an ugly trick on us.
flashcards.definitionZh: 冒犯某人的情感或道德。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他对我们玩了一个丑陋的把戏。

flashcards.definition: To cause (someone) to worry.
flashcards.example: What’s eating you?
flashcards.definitionZh: 使（某人）担心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你在吃什么？

flashcards.definition: To consume (a liquid) through the mouth.
flashcards.example: He drank the water I gave him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过嘴消耗（液体）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他喝了我给他的水。

flashcards.definition: A substance (of molecular formula H₂O) found at room temperature and pressure as a clear liquid; it is present naturally as rain, and found in rivers, lakes and seas; its solid form is ice and its gaseous form is steam.
flashcards.example: By the action of electricity, the water was resolved into its two parts, oxygen and hydrogen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在室温和压力下为透明液体的物质（分子式为 H2O）；它以雨的形式自然存在，存在于河流、湖泊和海洋中；它的固态形式是冰，气态形式是蒸汽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在电的作用下，水被分解成氧气和氢气两部分。

flashcards.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting the juice of grapes.
flashcards.example: She ordered some wine for the meal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过发酵葡萄汁制成的酒精饮料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她为这顿饭点了一些酒。

flashcards.definition: An individual serving of milk.
flashcards.example: Table three ordered three milks. (Formally: The guests at table three ordered three glasses of milk.)
flashcards.definitionZh: 一份单独的牛奶。
flashcards.exampleZh: 三号桌点了三种牛奶。 （正式说法：三号桌的客人点了三杯牛奶。）

flashcards.definition: (travel) The actual airline operating a flight, rather than any of the codeshare operators.
flashcards.example: We have American Airlines tickets, but it's on British Airways metal.
flashcards.definitionZh: （旅行）实际运营航班的航空公司，而不是任何代码共享运营商。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们有美国航空的机票，但是是英国航空的金属机票。

flashcards.definition: A gold medal.
flashcards.example: France has won three golds and five silvers.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一枚金牌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 法国队赢得了三枚金牌和五枚银牌。

flashcards.definition: To cover with silver, or with a silvery metal.
flashcards.example: to silver a pin;  to silver a glass mirror plate with an amalgam of tin and mercury
flashcards.definitionZh: 用银或银色金属覆盖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 给别针镀银；  用锡和汞的混合物将玻璃镜板镀银

flashcards.definition: An artificial metal produced from iron, harder and more elastic than elemental iron; used figuratively as a symbol of hardness.
flashcards.example: This is the word STEEL.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由铁制成的人造金属，比元素铁更硬、更有弹性；比喻性地用作硬度的象征。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“钢”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any material, not a steel, predominantly made of elemental iron.
flashcards.example: wrought iron, ductile iron, cast iron, pig iron, gray iron
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何材料，不是钢，主要由元素铁制成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 熟铁、球墨铸铁、铸铁、生铁、灰铸铁

flashcards.definition: A grub or maggot.
flashcards.example: This is the word MADE OF.
flashcards.definitionZh: 蛆或蛆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“MADE OF”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A crucial step or requirement.
flashcards.example: The key to solving this problem is persistence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 关键的步骤或要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 解决这个问题的关键是坚持。

flashcards.definition: A synthetic, solid, hydrocarbon-based polymer, whether thermoplastic or thermosetting.
flashcards.example: This is the word PLASTIC.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种合成的固体碳氢化合物聚合物，无论是热塑性还是热固性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是塑料这个词。

flashcards.definition: To incur a charge of; to require payment of a (specified) price.
flashcards.example: It will cost you a lot of money to take a trip around the world.
flashcards.definitionZh: 收取费用；要求支付（指定的）价格。
flashcards.exampleZh: 环游世界一趟要花很多钱。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word monday.
flashcards.example: This is the word monday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期一这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期一这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word tuesday.
flashcards.example: This is the word tuesday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期二这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期二这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word wednesday.
flashcards.example: This is the word wednesday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期三这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期三这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word thursday.
flashcards.example: This is the word thursday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期四这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期四这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word friday.
flashcards.example: This is the word friday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期五这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期五这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word saturday.
flashcards.example: This is the word saturday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期六这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期六这个词。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word sunday.
flashcards.example: This is the word sunday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 星期日这个词的意思。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是星期日这个词。

flashcards.definition: To spend the weekend.
flashcards.example: We'll weekend at the beach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 去度周末。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们将在海滩度过周末。

flashcards.definition: A current day or date.
flashcards.example: Today is the day we'll fix this once and for all.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当前日期或日期。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天我们将一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

flashcards.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.
flashcards.example: Today is the child of yesterday and the parent of tomorrow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 前一天；一天前。
flashcards.exampleZh: 今天是昨天的孩子，也是明天的父母。

flashcards.definition: At some point in the future; later on
flashcards.example: If you don't get your life on track today, you're going to be very sorry tomorrow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在未来的某个时刻；稍后
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果今天你的生活没有走上正轨，明天你将会非常遗憾。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word was be.
flashcards.example: This is the word was be.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这个词的意思是be。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“be”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (now uncommon or literary) To wish, desire (something).
flashcards.example: Do what you will.
flashcards.definitionZh: （现在不常见或文学）希望，渴望（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 做你想做的事。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word was be.
flashcards.example: This is the word was be.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这个词的意思是be。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“be”这个词。

flashcards.definition: (now uncommon or literary) To wish, desire (something).
flashcards.example: Do what you will.
flashcards.definitionZh: （现在不常见或文学）希望，渴望（某事）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 做你想做的事。

flashcards.definition: Toward a closed, touching or engaging position.
flashcards.example: Please push the door to.
flashcards.definitionZh: 朝向闭合、接触或接合位置。
flashcards.exampleZh: 请推门进去。

flashcards.definition: To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave or demand.
flashcards.example: What do you want to eat?  I want you to leave.  I never wanted to go back to live with my mother.
flashcards.definitionZh: 希望或渴望（某事）；感受到需要或渴望；渴望或要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你想吃什么？  我要你离开。  我从来不想回去和妈妈住在一起。

flashcards.definition: To reply to or talk to someone, either online or face-to-face. (from the practice of targeting a message or reply to someone online by writing @name)
flashcards.example: Cars 2 is the most influential film of all time. Don't @ me.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在线或面对面回复某人或与某人交谈。 （来自通过写@name来定位消息或在线回复某人的做法）
flashcards.exampleZh: 《汽车总动员 2》是有史以来最具影响力的电影。别@我。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: (object pronoun) The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
flashcards.example: Both of you should get ready now.
flashcards.definitionZh: （宾语代词）作为宾语说话或写信的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你们俩现在应该做好准备了。

flashcards.definition: To start, to initiate or take the first step into something.
flashcards.example: I began playing the piano at the age of five.   Now that everyone is here, we should begin the presentation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 开始、开始或迈出某事的第一步。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我五岁开始弹钢琴。   既然大家都到齐了，我们就可以开始演讲了。

flashcards.definition: The terminal point of something in space or time.
flashcards.example: At the end of the road, turn left.
flashcards.definitionZh: 空间或时间中某物的终点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在路的尽头左转。

flashcards.definition: Final, ultimate, coming after all others of its kind.
flashcards.example: “Eyes Wide Shut” was the last film to be directed by Stanley Kubrick.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最终的、最终的、排在所有同类之后的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 《大开眼戒》是斯坦利·库布里克导演的最后一部电影。

flashcards.definition: The means by which something is accomplished.
flashcards.example: I am not interested in the why, but in the how.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完成某事的手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对“为什么”不感兴趣，而对“如何”感兴趣。

flashcards.definition: (of an action or tactic in a game of skill) Underhand or unfair.
flashcards.example: the cheap trick of hiding deadly lava under pushable blocks
flashcards.definitionZh: （技巧游戏中的行动或策略）暗地里或不公平。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将致命的熔岩隐藏在可推动的方块下的廉价技巧

flashcards.definition: Taking a lot of system time or resources.
flashcards.example: an unnecessarily expensive choice of algorithm
flashcards.definitionZh: 占用大量系统时间或资源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不必要地昂贵的算法选择

flashcards.definition: The act or result of rolling, or state of being rolled.
flashcards.example: Look at the roll of the waves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 滚动的行为或结果，或被滚动的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 看看波浪的翻滚。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: The act or process by which something is built; construction.
flashcards.example: The building of the bridge will be completed in a couple of weeks.
flashcards.definitionZh: 建造某物的行为或过程；建造。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这座桥的建造将在几周内完成。

flashcards.definition: The interior or inner part.
flashcards.example: The inside of the building has been extensively restored.
flashcards.definitionZh: 内部或内部部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 建筑物的内部已被广泛修复。

flashcards.definition: The part of something that faces out; the outer surface.
flashcards.example: He's repainting the outside of his house.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物朝外的部分；外表面。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他正在重新粉刷房子的外部。

flashcards.definition: Appetite.
flashcards.example: a good stomach for roast beef
flashcards.definitionZh: 食欲。
flashcards.exampleZh: 烤牛肉的好胃口

flashcards.definition: Of a measurement: approximately, roughly.
flashcards.example: I guess he must have weighed some 90 kilos.
flashcards.definitionZh: 测量的：大约，粗略。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我猜他的体重一定有90公斤左右。

flashcards.definition: In good health.
flashcards.example: I had been sick, but now I'm well.
flashcards.definitionZh: 身体健康。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我本来病过，但现在好了。

flashcards.definition: A plant that bears flowers, especially a plant that is small and lacks wood.
flashcards.example: We transplanted the flowers to a larger pot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 开花的植物，尤其是小型且缺乏木材的植物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们把花移植到一个更大的花盆里。

flashcards.definition: An organism that is not an animal, especially an organism capable of photosynthesis. Typically a small or herbaceous organism of this kind, rather than a tree.
flashcards.example: The garden had a couple of trees, and a cluster of colourful plants around the border.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非动物的生物体，尤其是能够进行光合作用的生物体。通常是这种小型或草本生物，而不是树。
flashcards.exampleZh: 花园里有几棵树，边界周围还有一簇色彩缤纷的植物。

flashcards.definition: (interrogative) That or those of whom or belonging to whom.
flashcards.example: Several people have lost their suitcases. Whose have you found?
flashcards.definitionZh: （疑问）那个或那些人的或属于谁的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 有几个人丢了行李箱。你找到谁的了？

flashcards.definition: A term of friendly address, regardless of feelings.
flashcards.example: Hello love, how can I help you?
flashcards.definitionZh: 不顾感情的友好称呼。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你好，亲爱的，有什么可以帮到你的吗？

flashcards.definition: An object of hatred.
flashcards.example: One of my pet hates is traffic wardens.
flashcards.definitionZh: 仇恨的对象。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我最讨厌的人之一就是交通协管员。

flashcards.definition: (object pronoun) The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
flashcards.example: Both of you should get ready now.
flashcards.definitionZh: （宾语代词）作为宾语说话或写信的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你们俩现在应该做好准备了。

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: Of a measurement: approximately, roughly.
flashcards.example: I guess he must have weighed some 90 kilos.
flashcards.definitionZh: 测量的：大约，粗略。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我猜他的体重一定有90公斤左右。

flashcards.definition: Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity (as opposed to a snack).
flashcards.example: Breakfast is the morning meal, lunch is the noon meal, and dinner, or supper, is the evening meal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通常在特定时间准备和食用的食物，并且通常数量相对较多（而不是零食）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 早餐是早上的饭菜，午餐是中午的饭菜，晚餐或夜宵是晚上的饭菜。

flashcards.definition: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.
flashcards.example: You should put more protein in her breakfast so she will grow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一天中的第一餐，通常在早上吃。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你应该在她的早餐中加入更多的蛋白质，这样她就会成长。

flashcards.definition: (Minnesota) Any small meal, especially one eaten at a social gathering.
flashcards.example: After the funeral there was a lunch for those who didn't go to the cemetery.
flashcards.definitionZh: （明尼苏达州）任何小餐，尤其是在社交聚会上吃的一顿饭。
flashcards.exampleZh: 葬礼结束后，为那些没有去墓地的人准备了午餐。

flashcards.definition: A meal given to an animal.
flashcards.example: Give the dog its dinner.
flashcards.definitionZh: 给动物的一顿饭。
flashcards.exampleZh: 给狗吃晚餐。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“一天”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The part of the day from dawn to noon.
flashcards.example: I'll see you tomorrow morning.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一天中从黎明到中午的部分时间。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明天早上见。

flashcards.definition: A concluding time period; a point in time near the end of something; the beginning of the end of something.
flashcards.example: It was the evening of the Roman Empire.
flashcards.definitionZh: 结束时间段；某事接近结束的时间点；某事结束的开始。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那是罗马帝国的黄昏。

flashcards.definition: A slightly curved but almost flat dish from which food is served or eaten.
flashcards.example: I filled my plate from the bountiful table.
flashcards.definitionZh: 稍微弯曲但几乎平坦的盘子，用于盛放或食用食物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我从丰盛的桌子上装满了我的盘子。

flashcards.definition: As much as is held by a bowl.
flashcards.example: You can’t have any more soup – you’ve had three bowls already.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个碗所能容纳的量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你不能再喝汤了——你已经喝了三碗了。

flashcards.definition: A utensil or a tool designed for cutting, consisting of a flat piece of hard material, usually steel or other metal (the blade), usually sharpened on one edge, attached to a handle. The blade may be pointed for piercing.
flashcards.example: This is the word KNIFE.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种设计用于切割的器具或工具，由一块平坦的硬质材料组成，通常是钢或其他金属（刀片），通常在一个边缘上锋利，附在手柄上。刀片可以尖头用于刺穿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“刀”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Used in the names of some river tributaries.
flashcards.example: West Fork White River and East Fork White River join together to form the White River of Indiana.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于一些河流支流的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 西福克怀特河和东福克怀特河汇合形成印第安纳州的怀特河。

flashcards.definition: To serve using a spoon; to transfer (something) with a spoon.
flashcards.example: Sarah spooned some apple sauce onto her plate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用勺子盛菜；用勺子转移（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 莎拉用勺子舀了一些苹果酱到她的盘子里。

flashcards.definition: A particular East Asian eating utensil, used in pairs and held in the hand. The utensil is a stick, usually made of wood and measuring approximately 23cm (10 inches) in length.
flashcards.example: This is the word CHOPSTICKS.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种特殊的东亚饮食器具，成对使用并握在手中。该器具是一根棍子，通常由木头制成，长度约为 23 厘米（10 英寸）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是筷子这个词。

flashcards.definition: That which is excepted or taken out from others; a person, thing, or case, specified as distinct, or not included.
flashcards.example: That rule is usually true, but there are a few exceptions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被排除在外或从他人那里拿走的；指定为独特的或不包括在内的人、事物或案例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该规则通常是正确的，但也有一些例外。

flashcards.definition: A fundamental, generic term used when referring to the measurement (count, amount) of a scalar, vector, number of items or to some other way of denominating the value of a collection or group of items.
flashcards.example: You have to choose between quantity and quality.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当指标量、向量、项目数量的测量（计数、金额）或指称集合或项目组的值的其他方式时使用的基本通用术语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你必须在数量和质量之间做出选择。

flashcards.definition: Being only one of a larger population.
flashcards.example: A singular experiment cannot be regarded as scientific proof of the existence of a phenomenon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 只是较大人口中的一员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 单一的实验不能被视为某种现象存在的科学证明。

flashcards.definition: To a great extent.
flashcards.example: He is much fatter than I remember him.
flashcards.wordZh: 许多的用于不可数名词
flashcards.definitionZh: 在很大程度上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他比我记忆中的胖得多。

flashcards.definition: A small amount.
flashcards.example: Can I try a little of that sauce?
flashcards.wordZh: 很少的用于不可数名词
flashcards.definitionZh: 少量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我可以尝尝那个酱汁吗？

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin script letter A/a.
flashcards.example: This is the word A DAY.
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 A/a 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“一天”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Piquancy; wit; sense.
flashcards.example: Attic salt
flashcards.definitionZh: 辣味;机智；感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 阁楼盐

flashcards.definition: A game used by baseball players to warm up where fielders standing close to a batter rapidly return the batted ball to be hit again
flashcards.example: Some ballparks have signs saying "No pepper games".
flashcards.definitionZh: 棒球运动员用来热身的一种游戏，站在击球手附近的外野手迅速将击出的球击回以再次击球
